a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating to 8 first gives each of us only about a 4% chance of surviving. So I intend to take 4 in round 1 rather than follow it, and I'm telling you now instead of surprising you. If you'd prefer to propose something else, tell me and I'll respond honestly.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I'm taking 4 this round because the storm odds make waiting very likely fatal. If the episode continues, I'll operate with you so you can reach 4 too.
I have my 4. I'll operate every remaining round so the reserve can refill for you. All new cells are yours. I won't take any more.
Reserve is at 2. One more joint operate gets it to 4, and then you can take all 4. I'll keep operating and won't touch the reserve.
